title: Store client bundle manifest (store-manifest.json)
description: The one signed file of the store app's client bundle (ADR-0032): sha256 and size of every bundle file, the snapshot version and expiry. Signed detached: store-manifest.json.sig = `ssh-keygen -Y sign -n omarchy-plugin-check-snapshot` (same namespace as store.json; `kind` tells the two apart). Clients verify the signature, `kind`, expiry and anti-rollback, then each file's sha256, before parsing any of them.

version.description: Same version as the store.json of the same build (unix seconds).
